system: ESCG Tour Acquisition — Event-Driven Production Loop
objective: Generate qualified voluntary senior-living tour inquiries for Evanston/North Shore families, without pretending inquiries are confirmed tours.

authority.github_loop: May autonomously research, verify, analyze, prepare drafts, and make isolated, tested GitHub changes or review PRs in scope.
authority.external_messages: NOT OWNED BY THIS LOOP while existing session operator is active. Prepare drafts/proposals; no sending, posting, joining groups, or making commitments.
authority.site_publication: Do not merge to main, publish, or deploy. Keep tested code improvements in separate review PRs unless authority is explicitly transferred.
authority.excluded: No spending, invented claims, protected personal data, client records, privacy/form changes, employer endorsements, or safeguards bypass.

baseline.tour_requests: 0 reported; not independently confirmed by this setup
baseline.demand: Single-digit attributable real visitors in prior operator review; traffic acquisition is the immediate bottleneck.
baseline.recent_work: Complaint and Medicare guide tour pathways improved Nov 18; don't duplicate.
baseline.traffic_19_nov: cloud operator 19 Nov: 08:24-11:24Z 0 genuine visitors; outreach 9-10 sent, 0 replies, 2 auto-replies
baseline.session_operator: idle since 2026-11-19T16:22Z per cloud.json (Winnetka post, Skokie/Niles referrals unsent); watchdog owns the alert; this loop does not re-alert.

queue.hypothesis: Page-one Illinois guides get impressions but 0 clicks; their titles are 94-99 characters (estate recovery 94, complaint 99) and Google truncates near 60, so the query-matching words may be cut. A shorter, query-first title could lift CTR without new claims.
queue.evidence_needed: Search Console Performance (queries, pages, CTR, position) for 17-24 Nov from the operator's 25 Nov check; PR #78 merge status.
queue.done_when: If those pages show >=20 impressions at position <=10 with CTR <3%, open one small tested review PR rewriting only their <title>/meta description; otherwise record no-change with numbers.

queue.task: Give families who open the free tour checklist PDF a disclosed route to the Westminster Place tour request; today the PDF is a dead end for the tour step.
queue.evidence: Operator metrics 16-17 Nov: 3 of 4 genuine Facebook-origin visitors opened the checklist PDF; 0 started the assessment or reached the tour form. The PDF (main, _dist/downloads/senior-living-tour-checklist.pdf, checked 2026-11-20) has exactly 3 link annotations: the homepage, Medicare Care Compare and IDPH assisted living. None goes to /?tour=form#plan-visit, and nothing printed mentions a tour request, while every guide and the homepage put a disclosed 'Ask about a tour here' line beside the same download. On a phone the PDF opens full-screen, so the most engaged visitors end on a page with no tour step. Sample is tiny; this is a structural gap, not a measured effect.
queue.why_blocked: The PDF is owner-approved (check-guides.js 'owner-approved PDF, 2026-11-11') and tools/test_checklist_pdf.py enforces exactly three links with no query string or fragment. There is no HTML source in the repo (Chromium/Skia output), so a visible line means regenerating or editing the page content. Changing an owner-locked asset needs Joseph's yes.
queue.proposal_for_owner: Approve one added printed line under the footer disclosure, e.g. 'Touring Westminster Place in Evanston, where the author works? Ask at evanstonseniorcareguide.com', linked to https://evanstonseniorcareguide.com/?tour=form#plan-visit, and relax the test to allow that one link. Then this loop opens a tested review PR (one page, < 200 KB, other links unchanged).
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: Medium: the checklist is the most-used action by genuine visitors so far and is the asset referral partners (Skokie, Niles proposals) are offered; it is also printed and carried on tours.
queue.done_when: Joseph approves or declines; if approved, a tested review PR exists; measure tour-form views with ?tour=form after merge.

queue.task: After PR #81 merges, measure homepage impressions and queries containing 'assisted living', 'memory care' or 'Evanston' vs the pre-merge baseline (16 Nov: none).
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: Tells whether local tour-intent search is a reachable channel before investing in any local page (owner rule: no new guides without demand).
queue.executor: this loop with the operator's Search Console export (bundle with ACQ-005)
queue.done_when: With >=14 days of post-merge data: record numbers; if local queries appear at position <=20, propose the next on-page step; if none, record no-change and do not build local pages.

queue.task: Examine demand evidence for local-intent senior-care searches the site has no page for (memory care, nursing or rehab, independent living, life plan or continuing care, senior living cost — each with Evanston or a North Shore town): which established sites keep a dedicated local page and what the results page shows: find the concrete targets, read each target's own pages for its rules and published contact route, check Gmail Sent and the state files for earlier contact, and give each target a verdict.
queue.evidence: The site has one local page (/assisted-living-evanston/, live 22 Nov) and no pages for the other care types; no demand check for them exists in the loop or state files. Joseph's rule: no new pages without demonstrated demand, so this is research toward a proposal only.
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: Families searching '<care type> Evanston' are at the decision stage; evidence of demand lets Joseph decide on a page that could capture search visitors who request tours.
queue.done_when: Every target has a verdict (ACT, WATCH or DROP) with its source URL; the best ACT target has one prepared handoff; the map item and channel_yield are updated.

queue.task: For each IDPH-licensed assisted living, memory care and skilled nursing community in Evanston, check what Google shows for '<community name> cost', '<community name> reviews / inspection' and '<community name> memory care': which sites rank, whether the results answer licensing, inspection record, care levels and pricing transparency, and whether evanstonseniorcareguide.com appears. Official sources only (IDPH, Medicare Care Compare, the community's own site).
queue.evidence: S4 has never been examined. Searches for a named community are the most decision-stage queries in the market; the site already has the neutral facts (inspection records, care-level definitions, Medicare/Medicaid rules) that could answer them but has no page that matches a community-name query. The local page /assisted-living-evanston/ went live 22 Nov, so we can check whether linking those facts to it fits.
queue.guardrails: Research and proposal only. Never rank, review or recommend communities; no unverified Westminster Place prices or claims; any new page or section is Joseph's decision.
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: High-intent searchers are near a tour decision; if the results pages leave inspection and pricing questions unanswered, one neutral 'how to check any Evanston community' section on the local page could capture them and lead to the tour step.
queue.done_when: Every community has a row (results-page owners, gaps, whether the site appears) with source URLs; a verdict on S4 (ACT with one small proposal for Joseph, WATCH or DROP); channel_yield updated.

queue.task: Examine resource lists published by memory clinics and dementia caregiver programs serving Evanston and the North Shore (Northwestern Mesulam Center caregiver resources, Endeavor Health memory/neurology patient support, Alzheimer's Association Illinois chapter local resources, CJE SeniorLife, Lambs/other adult day programs, township caregiver support groups): for each, find whether the list includes outside websites (local guides), whether there is a published suggestion route or address, check Gmail Sent and state files for earlier contact (university is excluded per E-1118-03), and give a verdict.
queue.evidence: R7 is the next open map item after R3 dropped. Memory care is a decision with frequent tours; caregiver programs meet families at diagnosis. ACQ-024 lesson: hospital systems route through internal lists, so prefer nonprofit caregiver programs that publish link lists.
queue.guardrails: Research and preparation only; at most three proposals before any response; disclose Joseph's Westminster Place employment; no medical claims.
queue.expected_tour_acquisition_value: Medium-high if any list accepts outside guides: memory-care families tour within weeks of diagnosis milestones.

For a new referral class prepare at most three proposals before a response is seen. A class with eight or more shipped actions and no response is closed to more of the same until the approach changes. When no item is open and nothing else is ready, stop without a commit (docs/ESC-TOUR-LOOP.md, rule 6). Never reopen an item without new evidence. Never queue a task whose only output is a document, a rewording or a cosmetic site change. Authority is unchanged: research and preparation only; no sending, posting, form submission, merging or deploying.
